### Century Complete Now Selling New Homes from the Mid $200s at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC


September 15, 2026


New construction community offers quality and affordable two-story floor plans in Upstate South Carolina


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Attainable new homes in Anderson, SC:** Shockley Bend offers new single-family homes priced from the mid $200s
- **Flexible two-story floor plans:** Shockley Bend offers three two-story plans ranging from 1,566 to 1,965 square feet, with 3 to 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 1- to 2-car garages.
- **Quality features included:** Every home at Shockley Bend includes 36" full-overlay kitchen cabinets, Lyra Quartz countertops by Cosentino®, Kohler® plumbing fixtures, Shaw® luxury vinyl plank flooring, Schlage® satin nickel hardware, an Igloo® smart front door lock, and LG® stainless-steel appliances.
- **Prime Upstate location:** Shockley Bend sits minutes from downtown Anderson, SC, with convenient access to Lake Hartwell, Clemson, Greenville, and Atlanta.
- **Available to buy online:** Every available home at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC can be purchased through Century Complete's online homebuying experience.


ANDERSON, S.C.


, Sept. 15, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced that the Company's Century Complete brand is now selling at Shockley Bend, a new construction community in Anderson, South Carolina, offering quality two-story floor plans priced from the mid $200s.


**Learn more and explore available homes at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/ShockleyBendSC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774561-1&h=3128132171&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FShockleyBendSC&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FShockleyBendSC) **.**


"Shockley Bend offers buyers an attainable opportunity to own a brand-new home in a scenic, connected setting in Upstate South Carolina," said Cliff Niederpruem, Regional President. "With a strong selection of homesites available, buyers have the ability to choose from some of the most desirable locations in the community. Combined with meaningful incentives through our affiliate lender and pricing that remains highly competitive in the market, Shockley Bend stands out as one of the strongest overall value propositions for homebuyers in the area."


Homebuyers can choose from three two-story floor plans at Shockley Bend: the Auburn (1,566 square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 2-car garage), the Bennington (1,765 square feet, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 1-car garage), and the Berkshire (1,965 square feet, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 2-car garage). Every home includes 36" full-overlay kitchen cabinets, Lyra Quartz countertops by Cosentino, Kohler plumbing fixtures, Shaw luxury vinyl plank flooring, Schlage satin nickel hardware, an Igloo smart front door lock, and LG stainless-steel appliances.


**SHOCKLEY BEND | ANDERSON, SC**
*Now selling from the mid $200s*


- Three two-story floor plans
- 1,566 to 1,965 square feet, 3 to 4 bedrooms, and 2.5 bathrooms
- 1- to 2-car garages
- 36" full-overlay kitchen cabinets, Lyra Quartz countertops by Cosentino, Kohler plumbing fixtures, Shaw luxury vinyl plank flooring, Schlage satin nickel hardware, Igloo smart front door lock, and LG stainless-steel appliances
- Minutes from downtown Anderson
- Proximity to recreational opportunities at Lake Hartwell
- Convenient access to Clemson, Greenville, and Atlanta


**Community Location**
127 Moore Street
Anderson, SC 29624
864.539.2983


**VISIT OUR SALES STUDIO**


While our state-of-the-art online homebuying process allows you to buy on your terms—24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year—we also offer in-person assistance from local experts at our Sales Studio.


**Upstate Studio** 1401 Woodruff Road, Suite B
Greenville, SC 29615
864.539.2983


**THE FREEDOM OF ONLINE HOMEBUYING**


Century Complete is proud to feature its industry-first online homebuying experience on all available homes in South Carolina, allowing homebuyers to easily find their best fit and purchase when they're ready—all while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice. Homebuyers can further streamline the homebuying process by financing online with Century Complete's affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®.


**How it works:**


1. Shop homes at[CenturyCommunities.com](http://centurycommunities.com/)
2. Click "Buy Now" on any available home
3. Fill out a quick Buy Online form
4. Electronically submit an initial earnest money deposit
5. Electronically sign a purchase contract via DocuSign®


Learn more about the Buy Online experience at[www.CenturyCommunities.com/online-homebuying](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774561-1&h=1144866183&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** Where is Shockley Bend located?
**Answer:** Shockley Bend is a new Century Complete community in Anderson, South Carolina, with convenient access to Lake Hartwell, Clemson, Greenville, and Atlanta. The address is 127 Moore Street, Anderson, SC 29624.


**Question:** What is the pricing at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC?
**Answer:** New homes at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC are now selling from the mid $200s.


**Question:** What floor plans are available at Shockley Bend?
**Answer:** Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC offers three two-story plans: the Auburn (1,566 square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 2-car garage), the Bennington (1,765 square feet, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 1-car garage), and the Berkshire (1,965 square feet, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, 2-car garage).


**Question:** What features are included in the price at Shockley Bend?
**Answer:** Every home at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC comes standard with 36" full-overlay kitchen cabinets, Lyra Quartz countertops by Cosentino, Kohler plumbing fixtures, Shaw luxury vinyl plank flooring, Schlage satin nickel hardware, an Igloo smart front door lock, and LG stainless-steel appliances.


**Question:** Can I buy a home online at Shockley Bend?
**Answer:** Yes. Century Complete's industry-first online homebuying lets you shop available homes at Shockley Bend in Anderson, SC and complete your purchase through the Buy Now process, while continuing to work with your local real estate agent of choice.


**About Century Communities**


Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM®. Century is engaged in all aspects of homebuilding — including the acquisition, entitlement and development of land, along with the construction, innovative marketing and sale of quality homes designed to appeal to a wide range of homebuyers. The Company operates in 16 states and over 45 markets across the U.S., and also offers mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services in select markets through its Inspire Home Loans, Parkway Title, IHL Home Insurance Agency, and IHL Escrow subsidiaries. To learn more about Century Communities, please visit[www.centurycommunities.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774561-1&h=3571772860&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2F&a=www.centurycommunities.com) .
